comparison.objective: Re-spot two snooker balls using rule-dependent fallback spots; detailed setup and scoring are absent.
comparison.physical_skill: Ball placement and free-spot selection, not tool stabilization, hammering, fracture control, or fragment retrieval.
comparison.success_condition: Balls occupy the correct available spots; candidate requires physical tang fracture and complete fragment containment with insert tolerances preserved.
comparison.reason: Rule-based ball placement is meaningfully different from impact-driven insert finishing.
